payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP: dp[i][j] = max sum selecting i pictures with last at j, restricted by window size k. Transition from dp[i-1][j2] for j2 in (j-k, j).
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 2D table indexed by count of selected pictures (up to x) and index of last selected picture (up to n). This is a classic 2D state DP for a selection problem with window constraints, directly matching dp_2d_state.
